'''Chapter 1051''' is titled "Shogun of Wano Country, Kouzuki Momonosuke".

==Cover Page==
[[Germa 66's Ahh... An Emotionless Excursion]], Vol. 13: "Germa's Escape": The [[Vinsmoke Family|Germa siblings]] make their escape from the laboratory of [[Whole Cake Island]].

==Short Summary==
After the confusion is cleared up as the [[Animal Species/Wano Country Saga#Picture Tanishi|broadcast]] is being set up [[Yamato]] meets the rest of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] and announces his decision to join them despite some objections as [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] had not decided yet. As [[Kurozumi Tama|Tama]] remembers her past, the new [[Shogun]] [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] begins his speech, confirming that [[Kurozumi Orochi|Orochi]] and [[Kaidou]] are no more, with Momonosuke vowing to follow in his [[Kouzuki Oden|father]]'s footsteps.

==Long Summary==
The people of the [[Flower Capital]] start to calm down after realizing that the [[Artificial Devil Fruit|large pink dragon]] they saw was not [[Kaidou]], and following "[[Kouzuki Hiyori|Komurasaki]]" and "[[Denjiro|Kyoshiro]]" is [[Kin'emon]], [[Kawamatsu]], [[Inuarashi]], [[Nekomamushi]], [[Raizo]], [[Shinobu]], and [[Kikunojo]], who the people recognize as the [[Nine Red Scabbards]]. Shocked by this unexpected turn of events, the people start clamoring for a [[Animal Species/Wano Country Saga#Picture Tanishi|Picture Tanishi]] to transmit this historical development across [[Wano Country|Wano]].

Near [[Onigashima]]'s crash site, [[Yamato]] finally meets the rest of the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]], and while some were surprised to learn he was Kaidou's child, he assures them that he is not their enemy, and from here on out, he will be joining the Straw Hat Pirates; [[Usopp]] and [[Nami]] react with shock, [[Franky]] confusion, [[Brook]] and [[Sanji]] with glee, and [[Nico Robin|Robin]] with amusement. [[Jinbe]], however, says he is not convinced until [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] gives the say so, which Yamato accepts, though right now, Luffy and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] are being treated by [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]]. Yamato notices some [[Beasts Pirates]] fleeing and he and other Gifters yell for them to stay put. Usopp then asks [[Kurozumi Tama|Tama]] how long her [[Kibi Kibi no Mi|Devil Fruit powers]] last, and she reveals that the tamed Gifters will turn back to normal after a month. She also says that the animals get to choose what life they prefer as some stay tamed, and [[Speed]] confirms this saying she wants to remain by Tama's side, which she happily accepts, though she asks her to become her mother rather than her servant, which Speed becomes touched by.

In the transmission, [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] steps forward as the group bow to him, where he announces to all of Wano what has transpired. The citizens of Wano are shocked to learn he is the son of [[Kouzuki Oden]]; he continues to announce that they are now free from the tyrannical reign of Kaidou and [[Kurozumi Orochi]], and they will no longer have to charge to drink clean water, that there will be no more [[slavery]] and the factories that polluted their once beautiful land will be destroyed. This causes Tama to think back to when her parents died working in the factories and how she was eventually found by [[Kouzuki Sukiyaki|Tenguyama Hitetsu]], who assured her that the [[Kouzuki Family]]'s warriors would return, which gave her the strength to keep going. In the present, she cries into Nami's arms as she remembers Luffy's promise to her.

Momonosuke tells the people that on his voyage he met a powerful and passionate friend; together the formed the [[Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance]] and [[Raid on Onigashima|invaded Onigashima]]. To everyone's surprise, Momonosuke announced that Kaidou, Orochi and the Beast Pirates have all been defeated; The people of Wano cheer as they are finally free of those villains. Though Momonosuke starts to grow nervous, he pushes through and announces his name, and his adult-form is finally shown, where he declares himself Wano's new [[shogun]]; he asks the people of Wano to lend him their strength and together they will return Wano to glory. Everyone is brought to tears by Momonosuke's proclamation as Momonosuke reassures himself that he will keep his promise to his parents, after which he embraces his younger sister for a long-awaited hug.

As Momonosuke and the group walk away, the [[narration]] reveals that Momonosuke will become known as Wano's greatest shogun.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*The event in the [[Flower Capital]] is broadcasted across [[Wano Country]].
*The rest of the figures emerge from the smoke.
**[[Kin'emon]] is shown to be bandaged and conscious.
**[[Kikunojo]] is also conscious and is being carried by [[Nekomamushi]].
**[[Raizo]], [[Kawamatsu]], [[Inuarashi]], and [[Shinobu]] are also present.
**[[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]]'s adult appearance is shown.
***Momonosuke is wielding the [[Ame no Habakiri]].
***Momonosuke tells the people of Wano that [[Kaidou]], [[Kurozumi Orochi|Orochi]], and the [[Beasts Pirates]] were all [[Raid on Onigashima|defeated]] by the [[Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance]] and they all cheer in response.
***Momonosuke officially declares himself as the new [[Shogun]] of Wano.
***Momonosuke reunites with [[Kouzuki Hiyori|Hiyori]].
**The group follows Momonosuke inside the shogun castle.
*Many [[Beasts Pirates]] are seen retreating.
*[[Kurozumi Tama|Tama]]'s [[Kibi Kibi no Mi|ability]] is revealed to only last for one month, though some animals stay tamed.
**Tama's past is shown, including how she lost her parents and came to be raised by [[Kouzuki Sukiyaki|Tenguyama Hitetsu]].
*[[Speed]] claims she wants to stay with Tama while Tama desires Speed to become her new mother.
*[[Yamato]] meets the rest of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]].
**Yamato states he will be joining the crew as a crew member, despite some objections as [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] had not decided yet.
*Luffy and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] are unconscious and being tended to by [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]].
